Most positive evidence is system-level or program-level, while the strongest direct ministry evidence is the AIC/MOLISA patronage and mismanagement case.","evidence":[{"title":"Decree 110/2024 on social work professionalizes the field","publisher":"Thuvienphapluat / Government of Vietnam","date":"August 30, 2024","url":"https://thuvienphapluat.vn/van-ban/EN/Van-hoa-Xa-hoi/Decree-110-2024-ND-CP-social-work/627226/tieng-anh.aspx?tab=0","summary":"The decree sets rules for social work clients, practitioners, eligibility, and practice, which is evidence of formal professionalization in social services rather than pure patronage.","question_ids":["6B.4","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"UNICEF documents direct cash support to a disabled child’s family","publisher":"UNICEF Viet Nam","date":"July 11, 2024","url":"https://www.unicef.org/vietnam/stories/building-social-protection-system-improves-gender-equality","summary":"A family with a mentally disabled child received monthly government cash assistance that helped pay for food and schooling, showing concrete social protection delivery to a vulnerable household.","question_ids":["6B.4","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"UNICEF says Vietnam expanded professional social-work and counseling posts in health and education","publisher":"UNICEF Viet Nam","date":"2024","url":"https://www.unicef.org/vietnam/press-releases/unicef-applauds-viet-nams-progress-establishment-social-work-and-counseling","summary":"UNICEF says the government created defined social-worker posts in health facilities and school-counselor posts in all primary-to-secondary schools, with technical support for university-trained social workers.
